H3633H.name: Calcol
H3633H.brief: Son of Zerah, grandson of Judah
H3633H.short: Calcol, a son of Zerah, was a grandson of Judah.

H3633G.name: Calcol
H3633G.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H3633G.brief: Wise man Solomon was compared to
H3633G.short: Calcol was a wise man to whom Solomon's wisdom was compared.

H3612H.name: Caleb
H3612H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3612H.brief: Son of Hezron, descendant of Judah
H3612H.short: Caleb (Chelubai), the son of Hezron, was a descendant of Judah and the father of Hur.

H3612G.name: Caleb
H3612G.desc: Joshua's compatriot living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness and Conquest
H3612G.brief: Faithful spy, given Hebron as inheritance
H3612G.short: Caleb, one of the twelve spies, remained faithful to God and was granted Hebron as his inheritance.

H3667G.name: Canaan
H3667G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3667G.brief: Son of Ham; father of Sidon and Heth
H3667G.short: Canaan, the son of Ham, was the father of Sidon, Heth, and other Canaanite tribes.

H3669G.name: Canaanite woman
H3669G.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3669G.short: Shaul's mother was a Canaanite woman, according to the genealogies of Simeon.

H3695.name: Casluhim
H3695.brief: Descendants of Mizraim, ancestor of Philistines
H3695.short: The Casluhim, descendants of Mizraim, were the ancestors of the Philistines.

H3636.name: Chelal
H3636.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3636.brief: Israelite who married a foreign wife during Ezra's time
H3636.short: Chelal was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman during the time of Ezra.

H3620H.name: Chelub
H3620H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3620H.brief: Overseer of King David's farm workers
H3620H.short: Chelub the Ishmaelite was in charge of King David's farm workers.

H3620G.name: Chelub
H3620G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3620G.short: Chelub, Caleb's brother and Hezron's son, was Mehir's father.

H3622.name: Cheluhi
H3622.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3622.brief: A man who married a foreign woman
H3622.short: Cheluhi was among those who married foreign women during the Exile.

H3668H.name: Chenaanah
H3668H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3668H.brief: Son of Bilhan, descendant of Benjamin
H3668H.short: Chenaanah was a son of Bilhan and descendant of Benjamin.

H3668G.name: Chenaanah
H3668G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3668G.short: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah was a false prophet who opposed Micaiah.

H3662.name: Chenani
H3662.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3662.brief: Levite who led the people in confession
H3662.short: Chenani was a Levite who led the people in confession and worship.

H3663.name: Chenaniah
H3663.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3663.brief: Levite leader of singing and administration under David
H3663.short: Chenaniah was a Levite leader in charge of singing and administration during David's reign.

H3609.name: Chileab
H3609.desc: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
H3609.brief: Son of David and Abigail the Carmelitess
H3609.short: Chileab, also known as Daniel, was David's son by Abigail the Carmelitess.

H3630.name: Chilion
H3630.brief: Son of Elimelech and Naomi; husband of Orpah
H3630.short: Chilion was the son of Elimelech and Naomi, and the husband of Orpah.

H3643.name: Chimham
H3643.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H3643.brief: Barzillai's son, accompanied David to Jerusalem
H3643.short: Chimham, son of Barzillai, accompanied David to Jerusalem after Absalom's rebellion.

H3692.name: Chislon
H3692.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3692.brief: Father of Elidad, a leader from Benjamin
H3692.short: Chislon was the father of Elidad, a leader from the tribe of Benjamin.

H3626H.name: Col-hozeh
H3626H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3626H.brief: Ancestor of Maaseiah, who settled in Jerusalem
H3626H.short: Col-hozeh was an ancestor of Maaseiah, who settled in Jerusalem after the exile.

H3626G.name: Col-hozeh
H3626G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3626G.brief: Father of Shallum, who repaired the Fountain Gate
H3626G.short: Col-hozeh was the father of Shallum (or 'Shallun'), who repaired the Fountain Gate.

H3625.name: Calah
H3625.brief: Ancient Assyrian city built by Nimrod
H3625.short: Calah was an ancient Assyrian city built by Nimrod, along with Nineveh and Resen.

H3613.name: Caleb Ephrathah
H3613.short: Caleb Ephrathah was the place where Hezron, the son of Perez, died.

H3641A.name: Calneh
H3641A.brief: Ancient Mesopotamian city, possibly Kullania or Kullanhu
H3641A.short: Calneh (Calno) was an ancient city in Mesopotamia, mentioned as one of Nimrod's cities and later as a trading partner of Tyre.

H3667A.name: Canaan
H3667A.brief: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants
H3667A.short: Canaan was the ancient region between the Jordan River and the Mediterranean Sea, named after Noah's grandson and later promised to Abraham's descendants.

H3693.name: Chesalon
H3693.short: Chesalon, also known as Mount Jearim, was a landmark on the northern boundary of Judah, near Bethshemesh.

H3686.name: Chesil
H3686.short: Chesil was a town allotted to the tribe of Judah in the southern part of their territory.

H3694.name: Chesulloth
H3694.brief: Border town of Issachar and Zebulun
H3694.short: Chesulloth, also known as Chisloth-tabor or Tabor, was a town on the border between Issachar and Zebulun.

H3638.name: Chilmad
H3638.short: Chilmad was a place mentioned by Ezekiel as one of Tyre's trading partners.

H3672G.name: Chinnereth
H3672G.brief: Freshwater lake in northern Israel; location of Jesus' ministry
H3672G.short: Chinnereth, also known as the Sea of Galilee or the Sea of Tiberias, is a freshwater lake in northern Israel where Jesus conducted much of his ministry.

H3672H.name: Chinneroth
H3672H.brief: Region and city near the Sea of Galilee
H3672H.short: Chinneroth, also known as Chinnereth, was a region and a city near the Sea of Galilee, which was also called the Sea of Chinnereth.

H3645.name: Chemosh
H3645.brief: Moabite god, worshipped by Solomon and others
H3645.short: Chemosh, the god of the Moabites, was worshipped by Solomon and the Israelites, leading them into idolatry.

H3691.name: Chislev
H3691.brief: The ninth month in the ancient Hebrew calendar
H3691.short: Chislev, mentioned in <ref="Nehemiah 1:1">Nehemiah 1:1</ref> and <ref="Zechariah 7:1">Zechariah 7:1</ref>, is the ninth month in the ancient Hebrew calendar, corresponding to November-December in the modern calendar.

H3685G.name: Orion
H3685G.brief: A prominent constellation mentioned in the Bible
H3685G.short: Orion, a prominent constellation, is mentioned in <ref="Job.9.9, 38:31; Amo.5.8">Job.9.9, 38:31; Amo.5.8</ref> as a display of God's power and creative work in the heavens.
